Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Elections

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 507 as introduced could increase the expenditures of any county that elects to designate additional places or offices where an absentee election manager may perform his or her duties.
Bob Fincher, Chair
Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
